import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_D = 300; // Assuming maximum d as 300 to prevent large memory issues
    static final long M = 1000000007;
    static int n, d;
    static List<Long> v = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Node {
        long[][] dp = new long[MAX_D + 1][MAX_D + 1];
        long[][] cnt = new long[MAX_D + 1][MAX_D + 1];
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[MAX_D];
        boolean[] tark = new boolean[MAX_D];

        void mrg(Node nd) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= d; k++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = (cnt[i][j] + dp[k][j] * nd.dp[i][k]) % M;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                if (mark[i] && !nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[i][j] = dp[i][j];
                    }
                }
                if (!mark[i] && nd.mark[i]) {
                    for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                        cnt[j][i] = nd.dp[j][i];
                    }
                }
                mark[i] = mark[i] || nd.mark[i];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
        }

        void clean() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = 0;
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void shift(int x) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    cnt[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < d; j++) {
                    int ni = (i + x) % d;
                    int nj = (j + x) % d;
                    cnt[ni][nj] = dp[i][j];
                }
                cnt[(i + x) % d][d] = dp[i][d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                cnt[d][(i + x) % d] = dp[d][i];
            }
            cnt[d][d] = dp[d][d];

            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= d; j++) {
                    dp[i][j] = cnt[i][j];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                tark[i] = mark[(i + x) % d];
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                mark[i] = tark[i];
            }
        }
    }

    static Node[] md = new Node[MAX_D + 5];
    static Node[] hp = new Node[MAX_D + 5];
    static Node ht = new Node();

    static Node getNode(int x) {
        int h = x, pw = 1, t = -1;
        while (h >= d) {
            h /= d;
            pw *= d;
            t++;
        }
        x %= pw;
        if (t == -1) {
            return Arrays.copyOf(hp[h], 1); // shallow copy
        }
        Node ans = new Node();
        ans.dp = Arrays.copyOf(md[t].dp, md[t].dp.length);
        Node temp = new Node();
        temp.dp = Arrays.copyOf(md[t].dp, md[t].dp.length);
        for (int i = 1; i < h; i++) {
            temp.shift(1);
            ans.mrg(temp);
        }
        Node htNode = getNode(x);
        htNode.shift(h);
        ans.mrg(htNode);
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        // setup input
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        n--;
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            v.add(tempN % d);
            tempN /= d;
        }

        // initialize hp[0]
        hp[0] = new Node();
        hp[0].dp[d][d] = 2;
        hp[0].dp[d][0] = -1;
        hp[0].dp[0][d] = 1;
        hp[0].mark[0] = true;

        // initialize md[0]
        md[0] = new Node();
        md[0].dp = new long[d + 1][d + 1];
        md[0].dp[d][d] = 2;
        md[0].dp[d][0] = -1;
        md[0].dp[0][d] = 1;
        md[0].mark = new boolean[d];

        for (int i = 1; i < d; i++) {
            hp[i] = new Node();
            hp[i].dp[d][d] = 2;
            hp[i].dp[d][i] = -1;
            hp[i].dp[i][d] = 1;
            hp[i].mark[i] = true;

            md[0].mrg(hp[i]);
            // copy md[0] back to hp[i]
            hp[i] = new Node();
            hp[i].dp = Arrays.copyOf(md[0].dp, md[0].dp.length);
            hp[i].mark = Arrays.copyOf(md[0].mark, md[0].mark.length);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= v.size(); i++) {
            md[i] = new Node();
            md[i].dp = Arrays.copyOf(md[i - 1].dp, md[i - 1].dp.length);
            ht = new Node();
            ht.dp = Arrays.copyOf(md[i - 1].dp, md[i - 1].dp.length);
            for (int j = 1; j < d; j++) {
                ht.shift(1);
                md[i].mrg(ht);
            }
        }

        Node ans = getNode((int) n);
        System.out.println(ans.dp[d][d]);
    }
}
